title: Biscuit asks for the walk
logline: 8-second vertical clip: a dog in a kitchen looks straight at camera and asks, very politely, for its walk; one push-in, no cuts.

assets.role: the dog Biscuit, face straight on. Take the face, coat, markings and collar exactly.
Biscuit in profile, for the body shape and tail.
the kitchen. Its camera angle is the angle of the first frame.

look: Clean modern digital look, 35mm, warm morning light from the window at screen-right, deep clean blacks, colour rich and saturated, never washed out.

characters.name: Biscuit
characters.identity: Biscuit is a medium-sized golden retriever with a wavy honey-gold coat, a paler cream chest, dark brown eyes, soft floppy ears and a red leather collar with a round brass tag.
characters.voice: Speaks in a warm, slightly husky, very polite voice, unhurried.
characters.rule: Sits the whole time; only the head and mouth move.

positions.layout: In @loc_kitchen Biscuit sits on the tiled floor at screen-centre, facing camera, in front of the kitchen door.

behind.Biscuit: the closed white kitchen door with a lead hanging on its hook.

shots.camera: THE VERY FIRST FRAME IS this: camera at dog eye level, 35mm, Biscuit full body at screen-centre, exactly the angle of @loc_kitchen. A slow, steady push-in to a close-up of the face that never stops for the line.
shots.frame: Biscuit sits facing camera, eyes open, ears relaxed.
shots.background: the closed white kitchen door with the lead on its hook directly behind Biscuit; the window light at screen-right.
shots.action: 0.5s Biscuit glances up at the lead, then back to camera.

lines.text: Excuse me. It is exactly walk o'clock.
lines.delivery: looking straight into the lens, polite, a little pleased with itself

shots.cut: 4.5–8s Biscuit holds eye contact, tail sweeping the floor once; the push-in eases to a stop by 7.5s. No cut.

sound.ambience: Quiet kitchen: a fridge hum, a clock ticking, birds faintly through the window.
sound.voice: Clean, close, dry studio dialogue recording; the microphone never appears.

keep: Biscuit looks exactly like @biscuit_front and @biscuit_side in every frame: same coat, cream chest, red collar, brass tag.
The mouth moves naturally with the words: a real dog's jaw and tongue, no human lips or teeth.
Eyes open for the whole clip.
Biscuit stays seated at screen-centre; the camera move never stops for the line.
